# aimdk_msgs — provenance

ROS 2 interface package (message definitions only) from the AgiBot X2 SDK,
release `lx2501_3-v0.9.0.4`, vendored unmodified so the deploy node and the
docker sim image build from this repository alone.

Copyright AgiBot. Redistribution included here for AgiBot's review;
`package.xml` in the upstream SDK carries no license declaration, so this
package must not be treated as open-source until AgiBot confirms terms.
